question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the capitalised word in the given sentence.

I had the PRIVILEGE of meeting the magistrate.
solution:
The correct answer is “**Honour**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• '**Privilege**' refers to a special right, advantage, or immunity granted or available only to a particular person or group. (विशेषाधिकार)

 
 
• **Example**- She had the privilege of being invited to the royal banquet.
 
 
 
• '**Honour**' is similar in meaning to privilege as it denotes high respect or great esteem granted or acquired. (सम्मान) 
 
 
• **Example**- It was an honour for him to be invited to speak at the graduation ceremony.
 
 
 
• Hence, the option that is Similar in meaning to 'Privilege' is 'Honour’.

Therefore, the correct answer is **‘Option 3**’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• Let’s have a look at the meaning of the remaining options.
 
• '**Recommendation**' means a suggestion or proposal about the best course of action, especially one made by an authoritative body. (सिफारिश) 
 
• '**Guidance**' means advice or information given to resolve a problem or dilemma. (मार्गदर्शन) 
 
• '**Atrocity**' refers to an extremely wicked or cruel act, typically involving physical violence or injury. (अत्याचार)
